title: Central-north batch 5: German-language propers approvals, Speyer and Cologne approvals, Halberstadt, Huesca–Jaca, Beauvais, and calendar collations

uses.finding: Prot. 697/75 (11 July 1975) confirms the proper Mass texts of 23 German-language dioceses; each has a documented witnessless approval stage citing its printed page and entry. Cologne gains a 2002 approval stage; Essen a 2002 collect approval.
uses.limit: Summaries only; no proper book, feast list or language of the texts.

uses.finding: Notitiae 9 (1973) pp. 126–127: 15 Nov 1972, Prot. n. 2069, confirmation of 41 German-language diocesan calendars including Speyer; Notitiae 8 (1972) p. 361: 21 Sept 1972, Prot. 2069/71, common regional calendar. The Speyer 1975 stage carries propers only.
15 Nov 1972 collective confirmation covers the Swiss and Austrian diocesan calendars; January Salzburg 1498/1605 calendar change documented.
Halberstadt c.1498 and 1511 documented from MDZ; Lübeck and Merseburg have named gaps.
uses.next_sources: UB Leipzig III/243; USTC Lübeck copies.

uses.finding: amiet-usuarium-7335 is USTC 347646, a 1504 Zaragoza (Coci) missal for Huesca and Jaca; listed in both rows; provisional stage.
Noyon liturgy replaced by Roman from Pentecost 1857 (Gignoux mandate, per 1877 bibliography).
No sequence constructed; Vatican searches refused.
Prague 1845 stage from Pazour 1881 (provisional after cold review); Turku composite surveyed; Copenhagen 1510 colophon and Roskilde c.1484 leaf read.
